_source: Deterministic parse of raw Telair PBX CSV exports (ExportCallRecords, InboundCalls_Detailed, CallQueue_Detailed per queue) via scripts/parse_call_logs.py, replacing PDF text-extraction for this section per the Phase 3 raw-source ingestion plan. Cross-checked against Daily Operations Report - 6th October 2026.pdf's own cover/queue figures where they overlap.
_summaryVsGrandTotalNote: summary.accepted (329, from InboundCalls_Detailed scoped to this day's reception lines) is 2 short of grandTotal.accepted (331, summed from the per-queue CallQueue_Detailed exports) — the same ~2-call gap this project has seen on nearly every prior PDF-extracted date, now reproduced from raw data instead of PDF text. summary.missed (81) is far larger than grandTotal.missed (37): the extra 44 are preQueueAbandoned — real callers whose call never reached any specific queue (hung up during the opening IVR/menu) before any queue's own log could record them. The PDF's own cover pie only ever reported the queue-level figure (37, 90% accepted) and has never surfaced this pre-queue abandonment at all.
_preQueueAbandonedFlag: FLAG FOR USER: preQueueAbandoned is 43 today — much larger than the ~37 total queue-missed calls themselves, and far above what this metric would be on a typical day (it's usually a small fraction of queue-missed, not larger). Combined with this being the busiest inbound day in the last 10 (410 reception-line calls after target-number scoping, 368 by the PDF's own queue-only count), this may be worth a look — possibly IVR/menu slowness or an outage window that day rather than a data artifact. One caller even waited 447 seconds (nearly 7.5 minutes) in the IVR before giving up without ever reaching a queue.
_tenDayTrendNote: accepted/missed/answerRatePct/overallAvgWaitSec here are InboundCalls_Detailed-scoped (same basis as summary above, not grandTotal) chained from 2026-10-02's own committed trend — so missed/overallAvgWaitSec/answerRatePct for today (81 missed, 124s avg wait, 80% answer rate) include the pre-queue-abandoned calls and read rougher than the PDF's own cover-pie-based trend would (37 missed, 90%). Recorded on this consistent raw-data basis going forward rather than mixed with the PDF's queue-only convention.
_queuesNote: Per-queue accepted/missed/avgWaitSec chain-matched 2026-10-02's own committed data exactly at positions 0-8 (sourced here from the raw CallQueue_Detailed exports rather than PDF text). Appointments shows 209 accepted this date versus the PDF cover/queue tables' own 207 — a small 2-call divergence in the opposite direction found only in the raw data (likely two calls the PDF's own rendering dropped); recorded verbatim rather than reconciled, consistent with this project's standing data-integrity rule.
_patientServiceKpiNote: FLAG: this date's deterministic longestWaitingTimeSec (613 sec, General Enquiries, 12:39 PM, Ambrosie Brassil's call) diverges from what the source PDF's own panel reported (534 sec at 12:42 PM, Samantha Cooper) — the raw CallQueue_Detailed export's own CallTimeToAnswer field (the consistent, authoritative field parse_call_logs.py uses throughout) shows a higher-waiting call than the PDF's rendering surfaced. The PDF's 534 figure corresponds to that same 12:42 PM call's UserTimeToAnswer (521 CallTimeToAnswer / 534 UserTimeToAnswer) rather than its CallTimeToAnswer — the same two-candidate-field ambiguity this project has flagged before, now resolved by consistently preferring CallTimeToAnswer from raw data over whichever field the PDF's own rendering happened to use.
_inboundByStaffNote: Full table from InboundCalls_Detailed, scoped to this day's reception lines. Sums to 331 (2 over grandTotal's 329 queue-summed accepted) — matches the PDF's own cover pie accepted figure (331) exactly.

_outboundNote: outboundByStaff (199 calls) is the known-staff-roster-filtered total; outboundOtherExtensionsTotal (95 calls) covers doctors'/other rooms' direct outbound calls from the same raw export, kept separate as in prior known-staff filtering work. The source PDF's own 'Total Outbound Calls = 174' caption undercounts true reception-staff outbound activity by 25 calls relative to this raw count — consistent with the previously-identified PDF outbound undercount, not a new issue.
_outboundTenDayTrendNote: Position 9 here (199) is this date's own known-staff-filtered raw total, not the PDF's 'Total Outbound Calls = 174' caption — the first genuinely raw-sourced point in this trend; positions 0-8 remain the PDF-extraction-era carried-forward values from 2026-10-02, so this trend's basis changes from this date onward (expect a small step rather than a smooth continuation).
